biological.citation: Integrating single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics reveals MDK-NCL dependent immunosuppressive environment in endometrial carcinoma (PMID: 37081869)
biological.summary: Cell-cell communication analysis of scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics placed NCL as the receptor in the MK (midkine) pathway. MDK-NCL signaling from malignant epithelial cells to endothelial cells was confirmed between spatial neighbors. NCL expression was inversely correlated with ImmuneScore in TCGA and GEO data.
biological.sample_size: 33,162 cells from 5 scRNA-seq datasets, 1 ST dataset, 569 TCGA-UCEC RNA-seq samples

biological.citation: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics integration reveals FAM49B promotes tumor-associated macrophages polarization in colorectal cancer via the MK pathway (PMID: 41246334)
biological.summary: In colorectal cancer, MDK-NCL signaling from High_FAM49B epithelial cells to macrophages drives TAM polarization. NCL upregulation accompanied the CXCL3+ to SPP1+ TAM transition in pseudotime analysis, and NCL+ TAMs co-localized with MDK+ epithelial cells spatially. FAM49B knockdown reduced MDK expression.
biological.sample_size: 33 scRNA-seq samples from 16 CRC patients, 2 paired ST samples

biological.citation: Integrative single-cell and spatial transcriptomics analysis reveals MDK-NCL pathway's role in shaping the immunosuppressive environment of lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 40396179)
biological.summary: NCL and MDK mRNA and protein were significantly upregulated in LUAD tumors compared with normal tissue, validated by qPCR and western blot in an in-house cohort. MDK-NCL signaling was enriched at the tumor-immune interface. High MDK-NCL expression correlated with reduced immune infiltration, higher TMB and MSI, higher PD-1 and CTLA-4, and poorer survival.
biological.sample_size: TCGA-LUAD plus in-house paired tumor/normal cohort
biological.significance: Significant upregulation in tumor vs normal (reported as significant)

biological.summary: NCL is a membrane-nucleus shuttling protein recognized by the AS1411 aptamer, and it forms a complex with the E3 ligase MDM2. AS1411 anchoring of the NCL-MDM2 complex was used to recruit MDM2 and degrade STAT3, c-Myc, p53-R175H and AR-V7 in tumor cells and in vivo.

biological.citation: Phase separation of circCHD6-encoded 216aa protein promotes colorectal cancer metastasis (PMID: 41120080)
biological.summary: circCHD6-216aa binds nucleolin and stabilizes NCL's phase-separated nuclear condensates. This promotes NCL-dependent transcription of CD44 and drives CRC metastasis.

biological.citation: NF-κB1 p50 stabilizes HIF-1α protein through suppression of ATG7-dependent autophagy (PMID: 36575197)
biological.summary: In p50-/- cells under arsenic exposure, NCL protein translation increased. NCL binds Sp1 mRNA and stabilizes it, which raises ATG7 transcription and autophagy. miR-494 targets the NCL 3'-UTR to inhibit its translation.

biological.citation: Nucleolin loss of function leads to aberrant Fibroblast Growth Factor signaling and craniofacial anomalies (PMID: 35762670)
biological.summary: ncl-/- zebrafish show craniofacial anomalies with reduced rRNA synthesis and p53-dependent apoptosis. NCL also stabilizes fgf8a mRNA, so loss shortens its half-life and disrupts Fgf signaling, Sox9a-mediated chondrogenesis and Runx2-mediated osteogenesis. Exogenous FGF8 rescued the phenotype.

biological.citation: Aptamer-based approaches to detect nucleolin in prostate cancer (PMID: 33676639)
biological.summary: NCL protein was markedly higher in PBMC lysates of prostate cancer patients (mean 626.1 pg/mL) than in healthy controls (mean 198.5 pg/mL), with greater levels in advanced stages. The modified AS1411-N5 G-quadruplex aptamer bound NCL with KD of about 138 nM.

biological.citation: Targeting epigenetic pathway with gold nanoparticles for acute myeloid leukemia therapy (PMID: 29554483)
biological.summary: NCL was identified as part of an NCL/miR-221/NFκB/DNMT1 axis that promotes aggressive AML. Targeting it with AS1411 and anti-miR-221 nanoparticles reduced DNMT1 and global DNA methylation, restored p15INK4B and p27Kip1, blocked proliferation and clonogenicity, and extended survival in an AML animal model.

biological.citation: ASHG 2011 - Genome-wide association analyses in up to 181,171 individuals reveal 14 new loci associated with heart rate
biological.summary: A heart rate-associated variant was associated with NCL transcript levels in blood (eQTL), which makes NCL one of 11 nearby transcripts implicated at the heart rate loci.
